title: Kaguya (SELENE) Multiband Imager (MI)
description: Products derived from the Kaguya Multiband Imager, a UVVIS and NIR multiband camera. Includes mineral abundance maps between 50N and 50S distributed by USGS Astrogeology, and oxide and Mg# maps between 65N and 65S calibrated with Chang'e-6 samples (Shi et al. 2026).
